README:
# Newly completed native controls and final original-nine receipt

This capsule preserves only the newly completed stationary wave-mapN24 and C0N32 original native cases, their completed81-snapshot wrapper/analyzer checks, and exact root releases/logs. C0N24 was already archived and is cross-linked by metadata only. The final original-nine batchreceipt records all cases finished: six failed and three completed/admitted. It does not certify a successful fixed matrix, continuation, a finite pulse under wave-map gauge, stability or convergence. Stationary-reference preservation and a completed C0 pulse are separate outcomes.

All copied logs/source retain byte-exact whitespace. Raw arrays, RST/BIN/NPY/NPZ/HDF/JSONL, executables/libraries/objects and everyfile>1MiB are metadata-only. Large stdout/analyzer records remain intact locally and are identified by hashes rather than trimmed. No shared batch/readback parent, old frozen archive, derivative source, bulk008 or running attempt is traversed. Collector preparation performs only metadata/hash checks; the collector is HELD pending a new exact root authorization. No science imports, source/probe/native call, assembly/eigen/propagation or native advance occurs.

The executed final-nine bookkeeping is also retained: all nine process statuses are explicit, six mandatory failed and three completed/admitted, no pending. All three candidate ratios are not_evaluable because required cases failed; matrix/t6/t12 remain false. Root authorization-preparation TypeError/missing-auth histories occurred before any scientific child and are mechanical preparation failures, not native/scientific run failures. Earlier v1/v2 registry sources remain unchanged. The first collector scope remains preserved locally and linked by metadata; this fresh002 scope is separately HELD.
